P.recommendation: Uniform over each listed finite service-panel context and the Cartesian requirement grid; a synthetic buyer-job population, not a deployment-frequency claim.

Q.recommendation: 0.5 P plus 0.5 uniform over registered near-limit question cells; if none exist use P and report unavailable enrichment. Freeze the conditioning, boundary metric and bank version before candidate evaluation.

w.recommendation: For a population-mean diagnostic use P(question)/Q(question), retain shared-bank clusters and report unweighted boundary diagnostics separately. No score weighting is adopted. Robust inner limits apply to every mandatory condition, not to a weighted mean.

exposure_E.recommendation: Use the challenge's separately approved E and remaining ledger exposure, never reset it for a new threshold, seed, task ID or model arm. Do not invent a common eight-Challenge E.

near_limit_bands.recommendation: Quantity-specific, producer-refinement-derived intervals; no packet comparison target is a certified uncertainty band.

feasible_none_feasible_mix.recommendation: Report both shares and unresolved coverage under P without forcing outcome quotas. Separately recommend at least one resolved none-feasible diagnostic when the supported bank permits it; a shortage is reported, not repaired by conditioning P on desirable answers.

historical_measured_cost.scope: One historical quiz batch, not the revised five-stratum EV design bank
